# Step 5: 差异表达

## 5.1 差异表达结果读取与注释

```{r}
ensure_module_result_layout("05_de")

de_raw <- read.delim(de_path, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
if (!"gene_id" %in% colnames(de_raw)) {
  stop("4.DE_analysis/DE_results 缺少 gene_id 列")
}

required_contrast_cols <- c("sampleA", "sampleB", "baseMeanA", "baseMeanB", "log2FoldChange")
missing_contrast_cols <- setdiff(required_contrast_cols, colnames(de_raw))
if (length(missing_contrast_cols) > 0) {
  stop("4.DE_analysis/DE_results 缺少方向标准化所需列: ", paste(missing_contrast_cols, collapse = ", "))
}
input_sample_a <- unique(as.character(de_raw$sampleA))
input_sample_b <- unique(as.character(de_raw$sampleB))
if (length(input_sample_a) != 1L || length(input_sample_b) != 1L) {
  stop("4.DE_analysis/DE_results 包含多个不一致的比较方向")
}
expected_sample_a <- group2_label
expected_sample_b <- group1_label
de_contrast_inverted <- FALSE
if (identical(input_sample_a, expected_sample_b) && identical(input_sample_b, expected_sample_a)) {
  old_base_mean_a <- de_raw$baseMeanA
  de_raw$baseMeanA <- de_raw$baseMeanB
  de_raw$baseMeanB <- old_base_mean_a
  de_raw$log2FoldChange <- -de_raw$log2FoldChange
  if ("stat" %in% colnames(de_raw)) de_raw$stat <- -de_raw$stat
  de_raw$sampleA <- expected_sample_a
  de_raw$sampleB <- expected_sample_b
  de_contrast_inverted <- TRUE
} else if (!identical(input_sample_a, expected_sample_a) || !identical(input_sample_b, expected_sample_b)) {
  stop(
    "4.DE_analysis/DE_results 比较方向无法标准化: 输入 ", input_sample_a, "-", input_sample_b,
    "，期望 ", expected_sample_a, "-", expected_sample_b
  )
}

write_csv_safe(
  data.frame(
    input_contrast = paste0(input_sample_a, " - ", input_sample_b),
    analysis_contrast = paste0(expected_sample_a, " - ", expected_sample_b),
    sign_inverted = de_contrast_inverted,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ),
  "result/05_de/5_0_contrast_manifest.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

de_result <- de_raw %>%
  mutate(
    gene_id = as.character(gene_id),
    ensembl_id = sub("\\.[0-9]+$", "", gene_id)
  )

anno <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  annotation_orgdb,
  keys = unique(de_result$ensembl_id),
  keytype = "ENSEMBL",
  columns = c("SYMBOL", "GENENAME", "ENTREZID")
) %>%
  distinct(ENSEMBL, .keep_all = TRUE)

de_result <- de_result %>%
  left_join(anno, by = c("ensembl_id" = "ENSEMBL")) %>%
  mutate(
    gene_label = dplyr::coalesce(SYMBOL, ensembl_id),
    significance_value = .data[[de_significance_column]],
    direction = case_when(
      is.na(significance_value) | significance_value >= de_pvalue_cutoff |
        is.na(log2FoldChange) | abs(log2FoldChange) < de_log2fc_cutoff ~ "ns",
      log2FoldChange >= de_log2fc_cutoff ~ "up",
      TRUE ~ "down"
    ),
    rank_score = sign(dplyr::coalesce(log2FoldChange, 0)) * -log10(dplyr::coalesce(pvalue, 1) + 1e-300)
  ) %>%
  arrange(pvalue, desc(abs(log2FoldChange)))

sig_de <- de_result %>% filter(direction != "ns")

write_csv_safe(de_result, "result/05_de/5_1_annotated_DE_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

## 5.2 DE 概览、火山图与 MA 图

```{r}
de_summary <- de_result %>%
  count(direction, name = "gene_count") %>%
  mutate(direction = factor(direction, levels = c("up", "down", "ns")))

threshold_advisory <- data.frame(
  threshold = c(
    "configured_significance_only",
    "configured_main_DE",
    "padj_lt_0.05",
    "padj_lt_0.05_abs_log2fc_ge_configured"
  ),
  gene_count = c(
    sum(!is.na(de_result$significance_value) & de_result$significance_value < de_pvalue_cutoff),
    sum(!is.na(de_result$significance_value) & de_result$significance_value < de_pvalue_cutoff & !is.na(de_result$log2FoldChange) & abs(de_result$log2FoldChange) >= de_log2fc_cutoff),
    sum(!is.na(de_result$padj) & de_result$padj < 0.05),
    sum(!is.na(de_result$padj) & de_result$padj < 0.05 & !is.na(de_result$log2FoldChange) & abs(de_result$log2FoldChange) >= de_log2fc_cutoff)
  ),
  note = c(
    paste0(de_significance_column, " < ", de_pvalue_cutoff),
    paste0(de_significance_column, " < ", de_pvalue_cutoff, " and |log2FC| >= ", de_log2fc_cutoff),
    "recommended FDR support count for stricter reporting",
    "recommended stricter DE support count for reporting sensitivity"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

de_summary_long <- bind_rows(
  de_summary %>%
    mutate(
      threshold = "current_main_direction",
      note = "gene count by current main DE direction"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(threshold, direction, gene_count, note),
  threshold_advisory %>%
    mutate(direction = "all") %>%
    dplyr::select(threshold, direction, gene_count, note)
)
write_csv_safe(de_summary_long, "result/05_de/5_2_DE_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)



de_barplot <- ggplot(de_summary, aes(x = direction, y = gene_count, fill = direction)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = viz_pal$de) +
  labs(title = "Differentially expressed genes", x = NULL, y = "Gene count") +
  theme_rnaseq_publication() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

save_plot_versions(
  de_barplot,
  primary = "result/05_de/5_3_DE_summary_barplot.pdf",
  width = 6,
  height = 4.5
)

volcano_tbl <- de_result
volcano_tbl$figure_significance <- figure_significance_values(
  volcano_tbl,
  pvalue_candidates = "pvalue",
  fdr_candidates = "padj"
)
volcano_tbl <- volcano_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    figure_direction = case_when(
      !is.finite(figure_significance) | figure_significance >= de_pvalue_cutoff |
        !is.finite(log2FoldChange) | abs(log2FoldChange) < de_log2fc_cutoff ~ "ns",
      log2FoldChange >= de_log2fc_cutoff ~ "up",
      TRUE ~ "down"
    ),
    label_score = ifelse(!is.finite(figure_significance) | !is.finite(log2FoldChange), 0, abs(log2FoldChange) * -log10(figure_significance + 1e-300)),
    label = ifelse(figure_direction != "ns" & rank(-label_score, ties.method = "first") <= 20, gene_label, NA)
  )

volcano_count_tbl <- volcano_tbl %>%
  count(direction = figure_direction, name = "gene_count") %>%
  filter(direction %in% c("up", "down")) %>%
  mutate(
    x = ifelse(
      direction == "up",
      max(volcano_tbl$log2FoldChange, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.98,
      min(volcano_tbl$log2FoldChange, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.98
    ),
    y = max(-log10(volcano_tbl$figure_significance + 1e-300), na.rm = TRUE) * 0.98,
    hjust = ifelse(direction == "up", 1, 0),
    label = ifelse(direction == "up", paste0("Up: ", gene_count), paste0("Down: ", gene_count))
  )

volcano_plot <- ggplot(volcano_tbl, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(figure_significance + 1e-300), color = figure_direction)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.75, size = 1.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(de_pvalue_cutoff), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-de_log2fc_cutoff, de_log2fc_cutoff), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = label), size = rnaseq_figure_text_size, na.rm = TRUE, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(
    data = volcano_count_tbl,
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = label, color = direction, hjust = hjust),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = rnaseq_figure_text_size,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = viz_pal$de, name = "Direction") +
  labs(title = "Differential expression volcano plot", x = "log2 fold change", y = figure_significance_axis_label()) +
  theme_rnaseq_publication()

save_plot_versions(
  volcano_plot,
  primary = "result/05_de/5_4_volcano_plot.pdf",
  width = 8.5,
  height = 6
)

ma_plot <- ggplot(de_result, aes(x = log10(baseMean + 1), y = log2FoldChange, color = direction)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 1.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-de_log2fc_cutoff, de_log2fc_cutoff), linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_manual(values = viz_pal$de) +
  labs(title = "Differential expression MA plot", x = "log10(baseMean + 1)", y = "log2 fold change") +
  theme_rnaseq_publication()

save_plot_versions(
  ma_plot,
  primary = "result/05_de/5_5_ma_plot.pdf",
  width = 8.5,
  height = 6
)
```

## 5.3 Top DE 基因热图与导出

```{r}
if (nrow(sig_de) > 0) {
  top_sig_ids <- sig_de %>%
    arrange(pvalue, desc(abs(log2FoldChange))) %>%
    slice_head(n = 50) %>%
    pull(gene_id)

  heatmap_mat <- log2(gene_exp[top_sig_ids, , drop = FALSE] + 1)
  heatmap_mat <- safe_scale_rows(heatmap_mat)
  row_labels <- de_result$gene_label[match(rownames(heatmap_mat), de_result$gene_id)]
  row_labels[is.na(row_labels)] <- rownames(heatmap_mat)[is.na(row_labels)]

  annotation_col <- data.frame(Group = sample_info[colnames(heatmap_mat), "group"])
  rownames(annotation_col) <- colnames(heatmap_mat)

  save_pheatmap_versions(
    primary = "result/05_de/5_6_top_DE_heatmap.pdf",
    width = 9,
    height = 11,
    expr = pheatmap::pheatmap(
      heatmap_mat,
      annotation_col = annotation_col,
      annotation_colors = list(Group = group_colors),
      show_rownames = TRUE,
      labels_row = row_labels,
      cluster_rows = TRUE,
      cluster_cols = TRUE,
      fontsize_row = rnaseq_figure_tick_size,
      fontsize_col = rnaseq_figure_tick_size,
      silent = TRUE
    )
  )

  top_up <- sig_de %>%
    filter(direction == "up") %>%
    arrange(pvalue, desc(log2FoldChange))
  top_down <- sig_de %>%
    filter(direction == "down") %>%
    arrange(pvalue, log2FoldChange)




  rank_tbl <- de_result %>%
    filter(!is.na(ENTREZID), !is.na(rank_score)) %>%
    group_by(ENTREZID) %>%
    slice_max(order_by = abs(rank_score), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(desc(rank_score))

  write.table(
    rank_tbl[, c("ENTREZID", "rank_score")],
    file = "result/05_de/5_9_gene_rank_for_GSEA.rnk",
    sep = "\t",
    quote = FALSE,
    row.names = FALSE,
    col.names = FALSE
  )
} else {
  rank_tbl <- data.frame()
}
```
